portInfo.description: Shetland’s principal commercial harbour and a northern cruise waypoint between Iceland/Faroes/Norway and the Scottish mainland. Town walking is the conservative plan; Jarlshof and beyond need coaches.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Mair's Pier / Holmsgarth 5 (alongside) + town-centre tender stage
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Town centre near landing stage per authority; outer sites need coaches.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Town centre near landing stage per authority; outer sites need coaches.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Know whether you are alongside or tendering before timing the museum.
